hypotheses.D0_hybrid_recomposition_is_exact: Residual-only plus exact attention and MLP Shapley vectors reconstruct full causal responses to maximum absolute error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.D1_residual_path_is_major: The world with downstream attention and MLP responses frozen has target projection at least 0.50 on every corpus.
hypotheses.D2_attention_response_is_material: Attention's Shapley target projection has absolute value at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.D3_mlp_response_is_material: MLP's Shapley target projection has absolute value at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.D4_attention_dominates_context_variation: Freezing attention reduces across-site Jacobian variance by at least 25 percent more than freezing MLP on every corpus.
hypotheses.D5_operator_interaction_is_material: The attention-by-MLP finite interaction has norm at least 10 percent of the full response norm on every corpus.
hypotheses.D6_operator_profile_transfers_ood: Each OOD Shapley target-projection profile is within 0.10 per component of FineWeb.
